A calm and pleasant shop where you can shop in peace, accompanied by discreet background music that isn't intrusive. The sales assistant was equally discreet but perfectly adequate.

The shelves are well-stocked, with many products that are hard to find elsewhere. I even went there specifically for a water fountain for my cat, which I couldn't find anywhere else! The prices are admittedly a bit high, but the unique nature of the products makes it worthwhile. I highly recommend it!

A very good experience at L’Animaliste Lyon 6. The place is welcoming and pleasant; you feel comfortable as soon as you walk in.

The staff are really very kind, attentive, and helpful. If you need advice or help finding a product, they take the time to assist you, which is very much appreciated.

The only slight drawback, which prevents it from getting five stars, is that there is absolutely no cell service inside. It's impossible to call your partner or the person you're shopping for to confirm the correct product. This is a bit of a nuisance.

But otherwise, no complaints about the welcome and service 👍

Animalis Lyon 6: very welcoming, the staff are friendly and helpful. The product wasn't available in store, so I ordered it online and received it in-store without any problems. The prices are a bit higher than online, but that's not a big deal, the store is nearby.

Well, let's say it's mainly for those who have dogs and cats; there's a good selection. There isn't much for rodents, which is a shame.

At the same time, the store isn't very big.

It's not like Animalis in St. Priest, which has a much wider selection (and a better location).
It's best to come by metro as there's no dedicated parking.

Very disappointed. I thought rodents would finally be a priority, but still not. I have chinchillas, and the selection of supplies is limited. There's only one brand of food (and not even the best), and there's far too little choice in accessories (houses). In short, I'll have to order from Animalis online again and pick it up in store, which is frustrating because I'd really like to find my products in-store to support the business, not the online service.
A new pet store in Lyon's 6th arrondissement, convenient and relatively well-stocked.
